title: Choose a new visual world (round 2)
question: The roll assigned Munich '72. Keep it, take the pick, or re-roll again.

options.label: Munich '72
options.lineage: Otl Aicher's 1972 Olympic identity: pictograms, strict grid, pastel colour bands
options.thesis: Your training as an Olympic programme: each session an event, each exercise an entry with its own colour band and pictogram system.
options.viewport: Workout page opens on a full-width colour band (Pull = light blue) with the section pictogram, then today's session as a programme of exercises; each exercise a tile with the animation and a big dose numeral.
options.risk: Pastel bands can feel polite; it needs strict grid discipline and big type to not look like a generic sports app.

raised.raise: Done marks stay on the surface: tap an exercise to mark it done for today, and the mark persists as the session's history.
One loudest entry per screen: the exercise name and animation dominate; everything else steps back.
Colour lives in bands and edges only; reading text stays on a calm, achromatic field.

options.label: Watch Face
options.thesis: The site as the bigger screen of your watch: black field, huge data figures, one colour per field.
options.viewport: One exercise per screen like a watch page: name, animation, cue fields; Next/Prev like the watch buttons.
options.risk: Closest to the dark fitness-app look most runs land on; strong but familiar.

options.label: Ray Gun Layout
options.thesis: Colliding type you feel before you read.

options.label: Flash Scrawl Sleeve
options.thesis: A flash photo defaced with marker.
options.viewport: Animation with scrawled marks over it.
options.case: Loses both axes: nightclub, not home gym.

options.label: Provenance Ribbon
options.thesis: One ribbon through an object's history.
options.case: Loses both axes: archival, not athletic.
options.kept: A continuous line can carry a sequence.

options.label: Iridescent Cloud
options.viewport: Quiet white pages with spectral hairlines.
options.case: Loses both axes: no link to training.
options.kept: Colour in bands and edges; text field calm.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.thesis: Stacked translucent sheets with zone ramps.
options.case: Loses both axes: a darkroom tool metaphor.
options.kept: Quantities in tabular figures with condensed legends.

options.label: Datamatics
options.kept: Total commitment to a strict palette.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean fitness-app reference, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Exercise cards with thumbnail, sets×reps chip, expandable cues.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every workout app by design.
